first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a guarded onboarding simplification test the most direct path to restoring qualified revenue without immediately sacrificing price integrity. Verify memory_86 because it directly supports the proposed intervention, and memory_73 because competitor pricing makes promotional pricing a consequential alternative whose revenue durability is uncertain. Monitor qualified activation, time-to-value, retention, and downstream pipeline quality rather than completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard, targeted onboarding-simplification experiment focused on self-serve accounts, where onboarding completion and activation are both declining. The verified source shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue 18% short term, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Track activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, 30-day retention, and renewal indicators, with rollback guardrails if downstream quality deteriorates.
